The main takeaway from our work is that
in order to learn to reconstruct objects in a few shot setting the network must learn a prior over shapes, which can be used to generalize to new categories.
the 3D reconstruction task can be seen as a form of few shot learning, where the network must learn to reason about the structure of a new object category from a few examples.
